title: Derived quotient reduction of a literal finite free model complex
statement: Fix $\ell,E,A,R_n,T,e,a,b,v$ as in [def-sfb-finite-model-quotient-coordinates]. Let $K$ be the literal model double complex of the integral scalar matrix $v:A^a\to A^b$ in degrees $-1,0$. Its derived extension along the actual integral-to-quotient coefficient map is isomorphic to $e.\mathrm{fixedDerived}^{-1}$ of the constant realization of $[R_n^a\xrightarrow{\bar v}R_n^b]$. The assertion holds for every matrix, including noninjective ones, and for ranks zero; it does not assume a module resolved by $K$ or any chart morphism.

proof.text: The proved modelFiniteFree helper of FiniteConstantModelResolution identifies each model free module with the corresponding finite direct sum of the regular module. The unit is flat and finite products of flat objects are flat; biproduct.isoProduct gives flatness of each free term. Outside degrees -1 and 0 the double complex is zero.

Install the strict bounds -1 and 0 and apply CochainComplex.kFlat_of_bounded_of_flat. The left-derived functor counit of extension is invertible on this K-flat complex. Compose its isomorphism with the two quotientCompQhIso comparisons to compute the derived extension by termwise ordinary extension.

Apply the ordinary matrix cochain isomorphism, localize it, and compose with mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the unit of the specified fixedDerived equivalence. This gives the internal complex defined in the quotient coordinates.

theorem free_complex_reduction (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (e : Encoding l E n T)
    (a b : ℕ) (v : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin a) (A l E)) :
    let := (Padic.coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue l E).toNormedField
    Nonempty
      ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E T n).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (HomologicalComplex.double
            ((FiniteConstantModel.modelFunctor (A l E) T).map
              (integralDifferential l E a b v))
            (c := ComplexShape.up ℤ) (i₀ := -1) (i₁ := 0) (by decide))) ≅
        internalComplex l E T n a b v e)
